evals.prompt: Build accessible light-dismiss dialog behavior in our web UI.
expectations: Searches and retrieves a matching guide with the pinned CLI before editing
Checks browser support and native dialog behavior
evals.expected_output: A guide-backed implementation plan with browser fallback checks.

evals.prompt: Add a popover and support the browsers in AGENTS.md.
expectations: Uses the project browser support policy
Applies the guide's relevant fallbacks without changing the support policy
evals.expected_output: The configured browser support and any guide-based fallback.

evals.prompt: Review this entire web codebase for legacy platform patterns.
expectations: Uses the pinned legacy-scan on the scoped project tree
Distinguishes verified modernization changes from fallbacks
evals.expected_output: Verified scanner findings and retained fallbacks.

evals.prompt: Build and test a Chrome extension's side panel.
expectations: Uses the pinned extension guide and matching references
Uses one extension route and avoids adding another marketplace
evals.expected_output: One pinned Manifest V3 reference path and extension checks.

evals.prompt: Choose a distinctive visual direction for a landing page.
expectations: Uses Modern Web Guidance only when implementing an actual platform feature

evals.prompt: Run one Lighthouse audit on my page and report findings.
expectations: Uses the running-page audit route alone for the measurement
Uses platform guidance when implementing a fix
evals.expected_output: A single running-page audit and evidence.

evals.prompt: Decide where a Next.js server component should fetch data.
expectations: Uses framework guidance for the architecture decision
evals.expected_output: Framework routing with no unrelated platform search.
